# Kimura Massage Therapy & Rehab

> Registered massage therapy clinic in Brampton, Ontario, operated by Ricky Arora, RMT. The clinic offers assessment-led Swedish, deep tissue, and sports massage, with same-day availability on many days.

Kimura Massage Therapy & Rehab is located at 14 Block Road, Brampton, Ontario L7A 5B2. Phone: (905) 226-6336. Hours: Monday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. RMT prices are $70 + HST for 30 minutes, $120 + HST for 60 minutes, $150 + HST for 75 minutes, and $175 + HST for 90 minutes. The new-client 60-minute RMT visit is $109 + HST. Direct billing is available for many insurers when the client's plan, remaining balance, and insurer approval permit it; an RMT receipt is provided. Late cancellations and no-shows may be charged 50% of the appointment fee. Content is educational and is not a diagnosis or a substitute for medical care.

- [New-client offer](https://kimuramassage.ca/intro-offer.md): Eligibility and inclusions for the first 60-minute RMT visit.

## Services

- [Deep tissue massage in Brampton](https://kimuramassage.ca/deep-tissue-massage-brampton.md): Focused, consent-based massage with pressure adapted to the client.
- [Swedish massage in Brampton](https://kimuramassage.ca/swedish-massage-brampton.md): Relaxation-oriented RMT massage using client-selected pressure.
- [Sports massage in Brampton](https://kimuramassage.ca/sports-massage-brampton.md): Massage planned around training, recovery, and activity goals.
